noi_dung:
1. WHY MUST WE SINCERELY REPENT TO KARMIC CREDITORS? (karmic creditors)

After passing away, many souls remain attached to the earthly realm, unwilling to seek rebirth because they cannot release deep grievances, anger, and hatred. Among them, the most poignant are our **Karmic Creditors and Debtor Spirits (karmic creditors)**.

They are the spirits of human beings or animals who, in this lifetime or across countless past lifetimes, shared deep karmic enmities with us. In past lives, they may have been animals whom we slaughtered, hunted, or consumed; or human beings whom we abused, exploited, defrauded, injured, or killed; or aborted infant souls who were deprived of life. These actions created tangled knots of hatred and resentment across the wheel of saṃsāra.

When karmic conditions ripen, these spirits recognize their debtors. Driven by lingering pain and anger, they often follow close behind, causing disturbances to physical health, emotional well-being, family discord, or spiritual hindrances.

**How can these karmic grievances be truly resolved?**

Retaliation and confrontation only multiply suffering. The Buddha taught that hatred can never cease through hatred, but only through love, compassion, and sincere repentance. By holding sincere repentance ceremonies, sincerely acknowledging past wrongdoings, asking for their forgiveness, offering them spiritual merits, and guiding them to recite Amitābha Buddha's name for rebirth in the Pure Land, both practitioner and spirits are liberated from the shackles of vengeance.

**Preparation for the Practice:**

• Choose a quiet room or space before the Buddha altar or ancestral altar.

• Light incense, keep the mind calm, respectful, and free of fear.

• Recite with genuine remorse and heartfelt compassion, viewing these spirits as sentient beings who have suffered immense pain.

tieu_de: Liturgy of Sincere Repentance to Karmic Creditors
noi_dung:
THE LITURGY OF SINCERE REPENTANCE AND DELIVERANCE FOR KARMIC CREDITORS

*(Nghi Thức Sám Hối & Cầu Siêu karmic creditors)*

*(All recite in unison)*:

Bowing our heads to the Tathāgata,

Unequaled throughout the Ten Dharma Realms.

The Dharmakāya ever abides eternally,

His limitless transformation bodies endure hardships to deliver beings.

**HOMAGE TO THE BUDDHAS AND BODHISATTVAS**

Namo Fundamental Teacher Śākyamuni Buddha! (3 bows)

Namo Guide of the Western Paradise Amitābha Buddha! (1 bow)

Namo Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light King Buddha! (1 bow)

Namo Many Treasures (Prabhūtaratna) Tathāgata! (1 bow)

Namo Fearless (Abhayaṅkara) Tathāgata! (1 bow)

Namo Exquisite Form (Surūpakāya) Tathāgata! (1 bow)

Namo Vast Body (Vipulakāya) Tathāgata! (1 bow)

Namo Great Compassion Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva! (1 bow)

Namo Mahāsthāmaprāpta Bodhisattva! (1 bow)

Namo Great Vow Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva! (1 bow)

Namo Future Maitreya Buddha! (1 bow)

Namo Ever-Abiding Triple Gem of the Ten Directions! (1 bow)

**MANTRA FOR PURIFYING SPEECH KARMA**

Oṃ śucite śucite mahā-śucite śuśucite svāhā. (3 times)

**MANTRA FOR PURIFYING THE THREE KARMAS**

Oṃ svabhāva-śuddhāḥ sarva-dharmāḥ svabhāva-śuddho 'ham. (3 times)

**THE GREAT COMPASSION MANTRA**

*(Recite 3 times)*

namo ratnatrayāya • namo 'ryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya • oṃ sarva-rabhaye sidhyantu mantra-padāni svāhā • namas-kṛtvā imaṃ aryāvalokiteśvara-stavaṃ nīlakaṇṭha-nāma • hṛdayaṃ vartayiṣyāmi sarvārtha-sādhanaṃ śubham • aje yaṃ sarva-bhūtānāṃ bhava-mārga-viśodhakam • tadyathā: oṃ āloka-lokātīta krānta he hare mahābodhisattva • smara smara hṛdayam • kuru kuru karma • dhara dhara dharani-rāja • cala cala malla-vikrānte • ehy-ehi loka-jiteśvara rāga-viṣa-vināśana • dveṣa-viṣa-vināśana • moha-viṣa-vināśana • hulu hulu mālā • sara sara siri siri suru suru • buddhya buddhya bodhaya bodhaya • maitreya nīlakaṇṭha kāmasya darśanaṃ prahlādaya manaḥ svāhā • siddhāya svāhā • mahāsiddhāya svāhā • siddhayogeśvarāya svāhā • nīlakaṇṭhāya svāhā • padma-hastāya svāhā • cakra-yudhāya svāhā • namo ratnatrayāya • namo 'ryāvalokiteśvarāya svāhā.

**THE HEART OF PRAJÑĀPĀRAMITĀ SŪTRA (HEART SŪTRA)**

When Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara was practicing the profound Prajñāpāramitā, he illuminated the Five Skandhas and saw that they are all empty, thereby transcending all suffering and adversity. Śāriputra, form does not differ from emptiness; emptiness does not differ from form. Form itself is emptiness; emptiness itself is form. The same is true of feelings, perceptions, impulses, and consciousness... Therefore know that Prajñāpāramitā is the great transcendent mantra, the unexcelled mantra: *Gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā.*

**PRAYER OF SINCERE REPENTANCE BEFORE KARMIC CREDITORS**

I, disciple [Name / Dharma Name], with a deeply remorseful and sincere heart, speak to all my karmic creditors, ancestral spirits, and debtor beings across beginningless time:

"From beginningless lifetimes until this day, shrouded in delusion and driven by greed, anger, and ignorance, I have committed countless harmful actions. I have killed, abused, caused pain, resentment, and bitter suffering to you. Seeing the deep anguish you have endured, I now feel profound remorse and shame.

Today, before the compassionate presence of the Triple Gem, I openly disclose and sincerely repent all my past offenses. I beseech you with all my heart to accept my sincere apology and release all hatred, bitterness, and vengeance.

Holding on to grievances only binds us to ongoing cycles of rebirth and pain. Let us together take refuge in the Triple Gem, listen to the Buddha's holy names, and transform our minds into peace."

(1 bow)

**ASPIRATION FOR REBIRTH IN SUKHĀVATĪ**

Namo Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, Great Kindness and Great Compassion Amitābha Buddha. (1 bow)

**NAMO AMITĀBHA BUDDHA (NAMO A DI ĐÀ PHẬT)** (Recite 108 times)

**PURE LAND REBIRTH DHĀRAṆĪ**

Namo amitābhāya tathāgatāya tadyathā: amṛtodbhave amṛtasaṃbhave amṛtavikrānte amṛtavikrāntagāmini gagana kīrtikare svāhā. (3 times)

**THE THREE REFUGES**

I take refuge in the Buddha.

I take refuge in the Dharma.

I take refuge in the Sangha.

**DEDICATION OF MERIT**

May all merit and virtue accrued from this recitation

Be dedicated to all my karmic creditors and debtor spirits.

May your grievances be thoroughly extinguished,

Your hearts filled with tranquility and light,

And may you be swiftly reborn together in the Land of Ultimate Bliss.
